sample_context.visual_features: Dark linear fibers crossing the field of view.

execution_summary.trajectory: Started with low power/exposure, found signal too weak. Increased dose to 30% power and 5s exposure at a focused position on the fiber to improve SNR. Verified peaks via run_analysis.
execution_summary.outcome: Successfully acquired Raman spectrum of carbon fiber showing characteristic D and G bands.

lesson: For carbon fibers, 20% power / 2s exposure may be insufficient for strong signal; 30% power / 5s exposure provided a more usable spectrum without saturation (max ~2500 ADU).
